title: eng-platform
text:
eng-platform

jordan: Hey folks — PR 4823 is ready for final review, it touches the dashboard widgets + tracing hook integration. Can someone take a quick pass? Link: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/4823 :eyes:
sophia: @jordan grabbing it now. Quick Q: did you add the metric namespacing change we discussed so it doesn't clash with staging?
jordan: yep, added `metrics.namespace = \"console.prod.v2\"` and a short migration note in the PR description.
liam: I'll sanity-check the rollout policy and canary flags. If the canary is green I'll approve.
anya: I noticed one lint error in dashboard/overview.widget.ts — will push a tiny fix if that's okay?
jordan: please push, small fixes welcome. also note: if canary fails we fallback to v1 widgets automatically.
deploy-bot: CI passed on linux-x86, failing flakily on e2e-windows (known flake) — retrying.
sophia: spotted one potential NPE in trace hooks when span.tags is undefined. Pushing suggested guard now:
```
if (!span || !span.tags) return;
```
liam: thanks. after that and the lint fix I'm happy to approve. planning to merge in the 30–60m window depending on canary.
jordan: perfect — thanks everyone. tagging @oncall so ops are aware of the tracing schema bump. :+1:
anya: pushed lint fix and tests; CI requeued.
sophia: pushed guard change. CI green on my re-run.
liam: approved and added a short note to the release checklist about verifying dashboard metrics after merge.
deploy-bot: CI all green, merge queue opened.
jordan: merging in ~10m unless objections. If you see any regression ping #incidents. Appreciate the quick turnaround :rocket:
